utilities.name: DESCO
utilities.coverage_description: Northern Dhaka: Mirpur, Pallabi, Kafrul, Agargaon, Uttara, Uttarkhan, Dakshinkhan, Turag, Gulshan, Banani, Baridhara, Badda, Bashundhara, Khilkhet, and Tongi.
utilities.divisions_source: Observed in the S&D Division column of DESCO's own load-management schedule PDF (July 2026 edition).

utilities.name: DPDC
utilities.coverage_description: Southern Dhaka and Narayanganj: Old Dhaka, Dhanmondi, Motijheel, Ramna, Tejgaon, Khilgaon, Jatrabari, Postogola, Shyampur, Demra, plus Narayanganj, Fatulla, Siddhirganj.
utilities.divisions_source: The 36 zone PDF links published on DPDC's own load-shedding index page.

utilities.name: NESCO
utilities.coverage_description: Urban and municipal areas of the Rajshahi and Rangpur divisions.
utilities.divisions_source: Not verified. No per-zone schedule URL or zone list has been located on nesco.gov.bd. Their sheets are scanned images in the same hour-grid layout as DPDC's, which we read, so the obstacle is locating the files rather than reading them.

utilities.name: BPDB
utilities.coverage_description: Urban distribution in the Chattogram, Sylhet and Mymensingh divisions, plus generation nationwide.
utilities.divisions_source: Not verified from a primary source.

utilities.name: BREB
utilities.coverage_description: Rural areas nationwide, delivered through roughly 80 local Palli Bidyut Samity (PBS) cooperatives, each publishing separately.
utilities.divisions_source: Not verified. Each PBS runs its own site, so there is no single published list.

utilities.name: WZPDCL
utilities.full_name: West Zone Power Distribution Company Ltd
utilities.coverage_description: Urban areas of the Khulna and Barishal divisions.
utilities.divisions_source: Not verified from a primary source.

utilities.name: PGCB
utilities.coverage_description: National transmission grid. Does not serve consumers directly, but publishes daily generation and demand figures that explain why load shedding happens.
utilities.divisions_source: Not applicable - transmission operator, not a distributor.

utilities.name: Power Division
utilities.full_name: Power Division, Ministry of Power, Energy and Mineral Resources
utilities.coverage_description: The ministry overseeing all distributors. Operates the unified 16999 power-sector call centre.
utilities.divisions_source: Not applicable - ministry, not a distributor.
